card.name: General population and in Adults headings
card.fires_on: The word "general" in "in the general population" in sulfite sensitivity warnings, and "in" before "Adults" in dosing section headings such as pregabalin.

modes.label: General population
modes.description: The word "general" just before "population" when describing how common a sensitivity is.
modes.example: The overall prevalence of sulfite sensitivity in the<< general>> population is unknown and probably low.

modes.label: In Adults heading
modes.description: The word "in" after a condition name in a dosing heading, right before "Adults".
modes.example: 2.3 Postherpetic Neuralgia<< in>> Adults The recommended dose of pregabalin

card.writes: It suppresses sex words like male and female, which fits a spot where a population group word is expected instead.
card.plain: It fires where a label naming a patient group comes next, like "general population" or "in Adults".
